## Checklist

- [ ] `scripts/task check --changed` passes locally
- [ ] Bug fixes include the test that would have caught them
- [ ] User-facing app changes are under `## [Unreleased]` in that app's `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Anything the app's `CLAUDE.md` asks for (snapshots, eval numbers, screenshots)
